tagged_graph_cylinder_current.current_definition: T_nu(f,pi)=integral_Z integral_0^1 f(t,z)*partial_t pi(t,z) dt dnu(z) on [0,1]xZ
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.hybrid_identity: Gamma_cap=Gamma_G+trace_1(partial T_Gamma_B), with exact original graph records and no normalization/deletion/duplicate charge
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.metric_typing: a refined bounded complete compatible metric can make the finite endpoint/tag coordinate maps Lipschitz without changing the Borel sets; this is a bookkeeping topology
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.physical_trace: after the two disjoint labelled traces, the Lipschitz record projections give exactly landing_#nu and source_#nu
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.record_space: Z is the standard-Borel bad first-return graph record space including physical source/landing and n/path/ID/owner/once/D_land
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.type_guard: a normal metric current on the artificial tagged graph cylinder is not a physical collision-space anisotropic current, transfer-operator/Piola carrier, or singular cemetery
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.weighted_charge_guard: the weighted current traces are w*nu, not nu; the unweighted physical trace is recovered only by multiplying the boundary 0-currents by w^-1=2^-D_land
tagged_graph_cylinder_current.weighted_exact_identities: for w=2^D_land, M(T_(w nu))=||nu||_X and M(partial T_(w nu))=2||nu||_X
